title: First network detection search on the 8 March 2014 data held - pre-registration
written_before: any statistic in a predicted arrival window of 8 March 2014 is computed. Reader tests used only 'pre-registered background' IMOS records and whole-panel medians already in the data store.

source_grid.arc_points: 43 points of the dense sound-model grid, 41.0-20.0 S every 0.5 deg, on the 7th-arc line (tl_dense_bands.csv, src_lat/src_lon). Cross-arc offsets are NOT sampled anywhere.
source_grid.impact_time_basis: Window starts at the 00:19:29 log-on. Alternate-configuration dives reach the sea about 00:20-00:22:20; normal-configuration glides can last to about 00:40. 00:45 gives margin.
source_grid.Ea_prior: log-uniform on 10^1-10^10 J (used only for the credible limit and the Bayes factor)
source_grid.SEL_src: 170.8 + 10 log10(Ea / 1 J) dB re 1 uPa^2 s at 1 m
source_grid.band_fraction: integral of S(f) over the part of each third-octave band (edges fc*2^(+-1/6)) inside the station band, divided by fc*n/(n-1); S=1 below the corner, (f/fc)^-n above

timing.rule: Royer rule: onset = impact time + range_km / 1.480 km/s - 3.1 s; sd 8.6 s
timing.why: Calibrated on 143 hydrophone picks of 20 events on 7-8 Mar 2014 in the same ocean (median -3.1 s, sd 8.6 s; reproduced in reader test). The IDC rule (+10 s, sd 46 s) comes from earthquake T-phases with seismic legs; it does not apply to a water-borne source and would widen windows about five times. The IDC rule is used only for the earthquake association (section known_events).

window.coverage_rule: bins whose centre lies in the window are used; the window is OBSERVED if they cover >= 90 % of 60 s, else MISSING
window.note: If the final pd_curves.json gives a different window_s, the real run uses window_s with the same -1/3 : +2/3 split around the onset.

statistic_T1.P_ref: upper-5%-trimmed mean of bin power (energy/bin length) over bins in the SAME block (record or panel) with centre within 300 s of the window centre, excluding bins within 30 s of the window; at least 60 s of reference bins, else MISSING
statistic_T1.why_IMOS_10_40: 8 Hz hardware high-pass on the IMOS loggers

H01W.data: Kadri 2024 Fig. 9 trace 00:27-00:57; Royer 2016 H01W2 appendix spectrogram elsewhere in 00:01-02:03 (never both)

stations_excluded.SWAMS2, MAD, NCRO, WKER: only 3-min Royer event panels; no noise level held
stations_excluded.H08N: blocked from every arc point (Pete ruling)

noise_note: noise_level_db is the level in the station band, dB re 1 uPa (median-based values from the data store). Noise energy in the window = noise_level_db + 10 log10(window_s). Replaced by pd_curves.json noise_level_db in the real run.

provisional_inputs.level_correction: bias 0 dB, slope 0, sd 6 dB for every class
provisional_inputs.pd_curves: snr50 = 10 dB, sigma = 3 dB, threshold_snr_db = 10 dB (1/day) for every station; 1/hour row not run in dry mode
provisional_inputs.label: PROVISIONAL - every output of the dry run carries this label

prediction.SNR_pred_db: 10 log10(sum over bands of Ea-received band energy, with bias_db + slope_db_per_oct*log2(fc_band/10) added per band) - (noise_level_db + 10 log10(window_s))
prediction.path_class_dense: the class of the nearest sparse arc point (20, 25, 30, 35, 40 S) for the same station, unless the lead supplies a class for each dense path

network_likelihood.binary_primary: log LR(E) = sum over OBSERVED stations of D*log(P_detect/p_fa) + (1-D)*log((1-P_detect)/(1-p_fa)); D = 1 if SNR_obs >= threshold_snr_db
network_likelihood.graded_secondary: log LR(E) = sum log[ integral g0(R - 10^(u/10)) N(u; SNR_pred_nobias_sd, sd_db) du / g0(R) ]; g0 = Gaussian KDE (Scott) of ln R over all window positions of that station's own coverage at 30-s steps, mixed with weight 1/(n+1) log-uniform on R in [0.05, 1e4]
network_likelihood.missing: a MISSING station contributes factor 1 (no evidence). Missing is never a non-detection.
network_likelihood.cell_statistic: S(cell) = max over the Ea grid of log LR (>= 0); also Bayes factor = prior mean of LR
network_likelihood.best_cell: S_best = max over 43 points x 52 times x 3 corners
network_likelihood.independence: stations are combined as independent. Co-located loggers (Perth Canyon 3315/3376, Portland 3274/3275) are NOT independent: stated as a caveat; the time-slide null shifts each pair together so the null carries the same dependence.

upper_limits.exclusion90: smallest Ea with product over OBSERVED non-detecting stations of (1 - P_D) <= 0.10; detecting stations left out; '>1e10' if none
upper_limits.credible90: Ea where the posterior CDF (binary likelihood x log-uniform prior 10^1-10^10 J) reaches 0.90; prior-dependent, stated

A_time_slide_primary.offsets: independent per group. Digitised series: multiples of 30 s, |offset| >= 300 s, cyclic within the station's own data span. IMOS: multiples of 900 s (keeps the duty-cycle pattern), |offset| >= 3600 s, cyclic within the event-day dataset span. A window that crosses the wrap point is MISSING.
A_time_slide_primary.why: a coherent arrival pattern from one cell cannot survive independent offsets >= 5 min (>> 8.6 s timing sd); single-station transients stay in the null (they are part of H0)
A_time_slide_primary.p: empirical p of S_best = (1 + #null S_best >= observed) / (1 + n); per-cell local p from the null S of the same cell

B_common_shift_IMOS.offsets: all IMOS loggers shifted together by multiples of 900 s, |offset| >= 3 h, into the 8 Mar day and the 14-day background (3376, 3274, 3250); a logger with no data at the shifted time is MISSING
B_common_shift_IMOS.statistic: S_best over the IMOS-only network, compared with the observed IMOS-only S_best
B_common_shift_IMOS.why: offsets that cannot contain the event at all (strict version of the null)

catalogue: Royer 2016 picks (dg_royer_2016_royer_arrivals) and predicted arrivals of his 20 events (royer_event_labelled), sd 8.6 s
known_event table: pred_T_H01W / pred_T_H08S (IDC rule, sd 46 s)
Kadri 2024 Table 1 transients at Cape Leeuwin
CMST 2014 Fig. 5 / Fig. 7 detections and the 01:34:50 Cape Leeuwin event
Kadri 2019 Table 3 signals at Diego Garcia South
known_events.match: for each station window of a listed cell: every catalogue time within the window +- 3 sd; match likelihood exp(-0.5 (dt/sd)^2), dt = 0 inside the window; chance-match rate = fraction of null-A windows of that station with a match
known_events.rule: Royer's events B, C1-C4, D1, D2 and 'uncertain' events, the CMST 01:34:50 event and Kadri's transients are candidates, never explanations. An association is a label with a probability, never an exclusion.

outputs: per cell: Ea exclusion90 / credible90 per corner
best cells with empirical p and known-event matches
candidate list with no threshold (empirical p as a label)
per-station window list SNR_obs >= 3 dB with station empirical p
charts: upper-limit map (arc latitude x impact time, per corner); null distribution with observed best value
